subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved by the diagnostic-only exec warning in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94045, or should OpenClaw pursue same-user private-LAN reachability parity for gateway-host exec?
rationale: Source inspection can verify the missing diagnostic, but enabling or intentionally blocking private-LAN exec traffic is a security-boundary and product-policy choice.

options.title: Land Diagnostic Only
options.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while keeping actual LAN reachability policy under separate security trackers.

options.title: Design Access Parity
options.body: Treat same-user GUI/LaunchAgent parity as the goal and require a separate security design before implementation.

options.title: Defer To Policy Trackers
options.body: Reject the diagnostic-only scope and keep this behavior under the broader private-network policy issues.

recommendation.title: Land Diagnostic Only
recommendation.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while keeping actual LAN reachability policy under separate security trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: The current exec runtime/docs surface and deeper exec host-routing history most consistently route through this owner signal.
